findings.highlight: She swore that winter would shut away that final, major regret
findings.evidenceJa: 心残りを冬の間はしまい込み
findings.explanation: Setsuna resolves to put away her one major regret for the winter; the translation makes winter itself the agent that will shut it away.
findings.japanese:
「…ふぅっ」

　そして、その声も完全に消えた頃、雪菜も空を見上げ、白い息を吐く。

　今日は、本当に楽しかった。

　充実していた。

　中学の頃の、まだクラスの男子も女子も、自分を『雪菜』と呼んでいたあの日々の記憶がうっすらと蘇ってきた。

　だから、明日からも…

「合格おめでとう…かずさ」

　たった一つ、けれど大きな心残りを冬の間はしまい込み、卒業までの数日間をなんとか頑張っていこうと誓った。
findings.todokanai:
“…Phew.”

And, after their voices had vanished completely, Setsuna looked up at the sky, letting a white sigh out into the air.

Today had truly been a blast.

Supremely fulfilling.

It brought back faint memories of the days in middle school when all of her classmates, boys and girls alike, called her “Setsuna.”

And so, starting tomorrow…

“Congratulations on your acceptance… Kazusa.”

She swore that winter would shut away that final, major regret, and she would manage these next few days until graduation, somehow.

findings.highlight: If she could be in a pair again, and the group of five coming up
findings.evidenceJa: また、あの『二人』と、今度は『五人』や、もっとたくさんの人たちでいられれば
findings.explanation: Setsuna hopes to be with those two again, this time as part of a group of five or more. The translation turns あの二人 into her being in a pair and breaks the intended expansion of the trio.
findings.japanese:
だって、今はまだ『三人』は辛い。

　一番楽しくて、そして一番切ない時間のままだから。

　けれど、きっと春…

　新しい季節に、新しいキャンパスで、きっと新しい仲間たちとともに。

　また、あの『二人』と、今度は『五人』や、もっとたくさんの人たちでいられれば…

「よしっ」

　最後にもう一度、夜空に向かって白い息を吐き出すと…

　雪菜は、宴の後片付けの大変さに思いを馳せつつ、玄関の扉を開けた。
findings.todokanai:
Because being “the three of them” was still painful.

They were still in that most enjoyable, and most painful time.

But, in the spring…

In a new season, on a new campus, with new friends, surely…

If she could be in a pair again, and the group of five coming up, and with even more people…

“All right!”

Blowing a final white breath up toward the night sky…

Setsuna, turning her thoughts to what a chore cleaning up after the party was going to be, opened the front door.
